settings.heading: Checked before it ever ships.
settings.text: Every batch of Fizz is tested for what is in it, and what is not.

settings.heading: How we test
settings.text: Four checkpoints between the farm and your fridge.

settings.title: Source check
settings.text: Fruit and fiber arrive with documents and a sensory check.

settings.title: Batch test
settings.text: Each batch is sampled for sugar, fiber and carbonation.

settings.title: Lab review
settings.text: An independent lab confirms the label numbers.

settings.title: Final seal check
settings.text: Cans are inspected before packing and shipping.
